verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents an open-source version that runs as a standalone system needing only PostgreSQL, made up of a data plane and a control plane, and markets storing data on your own infrastructure. Community posts on its AGPL, SSPL and Elastic licensing confirm source-available code exists. The license shifts do not contradict self-hosting. Missing for 10: deployment documentation (Docker/Kubernetes guides, operational requirements), clarity on feature parity between self-hosted and cloud (e.g., whether Profiles, MCP and Rudder AI work self-hosted), and hands-on corroboration of running it self-hosted.
